title: Taking relief from abnormal course conditions in a bunker
question: Your ball is in a bunker and there is a puddle of water interfering with your stance. What options do you have under the Rules of Golf?

choices.text: Drop within one club-length in the bunker without penalty
Drop outside the bunker without penalty
Drop outside the bunker for one penalty stroke
Play the ball as it lies without penalty

explanation: You can drop in the bunker within one club-length with no penalty, or drop outside the bunker but take one penalty stroke. You may also choose to play the ball as it lies.
